title: Book Two · Chapter 127: The Page Before
story:
At twelve, Ronan has longer school days. Miss Wu's reading activity now meets on two afternoons each week. She has pupils from several classes, and the chairs fill quickly.

On a warm Tuesday she puts a short story on Ronan's table. The page begins with a girl at a shop.

SHE TAKES THE SMALL BAG.

Ronan reads the next line. The girl carries the bag home. A boy comes after her with a larger one.

Miss Wu asks him which bag has the bread.

“The small bag,” he says.

“Show me the words.”

He looks through the page. The last paragraph mentions bread. But this page does not say which bag holds it.

“I need another line.”

She gives him the page before it. At the bottom, the shopkeeper puts bread in the large bag and fruit in the small one.

Ronan moves his answer aside.

“The boy has the bread.”

“Why did your first answer come so quickly?”

“The girl came first on my page.”

Miss Wu gives him two more pages. “This is not a trick. Real pages can be separate. Tell me when part is missing.”

At the next table, a pupil has only the end of a notice. Ronan hears him ask for the top. The teacher gives it to him.

Ronan reads the whole shop story now. He lays the pages in order. He writes a short answer. He names the boy and the large bag. At the bottom he adds: I used both pages.

Leo joins him after his own task.

“Is that a shop story?”

“Yes. The first page was missing.”

“Did you ask?”

“Not at first.”

Leo sits down. “I did that at my activity. I thought a woman had two dogs. One was a picture on a wall.”

Ronan smiles. “Did the picture need dinner?”

“Only a painted dinner.”

They read the first paragraph together. The wall picture is not in Ronan's story. Leo draws a dog on a spare scrap of paper. He adds a bowl below it.

Miss Wu sees it as she passes.

“That is separate from the task?”

“Yes,” Leo says. “A very flat dog.”

She smiles and moves on.

Ronan finishes his own answer before he adds a little bone to Leo's picture. They put the drawing between their books for the walk home.

At the green door, Leo takes it back. It is his drawing. Ronan keeps the story pages in order and carries them inside. He leaves the folder closed. He can still remember which bag has the bread.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

missing＝缺少的；paragraph＝段落；separate＝分开的；scrap＝小纸片。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan第一次为什么答错袋子？
2. 缺少前页时应该做什么？

## 读句子

**He / lays the pages / in order.** 他／按顺序／铺好纸页。
